title: Implement rules, frontmatter paths, and include expansion
objective: Add original-equivalent .claude/rules, frontmatter path filtering, and @include semantics to the Go memory loader.
context: The original recursively reads .claude/rules/*.md and separates unconditional from conditional rules.
Conditional rules use frontmatter paths globs matched against target file paths.
@include syntax can pull in additional text files while avoiding code spans, code blocks, cycles, and excessive depth.
deliverables: Parse frontmatter and remove it from injected content.
Support paths frontmatter and glob matching for conditional rules.
Ignore include directives inside fenced code blocks and inline code.
Enforce include depth and cycle limits.
Skip binary or unsupported file extensions.
Expose external include metadata for later approval handling.
acceptance: Conditional rules inject only when the target path matches.
Include expansion order is deterministic and tested.
External includes are skipped unless explicitly allowed.
Circular includes terminate without duplicate content.
non_goals: Do not implement the UI approval dialog.
Do not implement full settings persistence.
handoff_notes: Use structured parsing where feasible; avoid fragile regexp-only parsing for markdown code-block awareness.
